name: mappair
algorithm: Hash map churn with a two-field key, a struct of two u64 (SH-3): key i is (mix(st), st) for the splitmix64 state st, inserted, each looked up once with a hit and once with a miss (mix(st), st ^ 1), every other key removed, all n looked up again; rounds times with a fresh map (README.md).

skip.c: no standard hash map in C
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; there is no checked arithmetic to remove

notes: Default hashes of a two-field key: Mk the fold hash through the key's Hash impl (Hasher.U64 per field, the finish inlined), Rust SipHash-1-3 of the tuple (RandomState), Zig std.hash.autoHash of the struct into Wyhash seed 0, Go the runtime AES hash of the 16 bytes.

Publish size 1000000 12 1: at 10 rounds the fastest cell (Zig ReleaseFast) ran 0.93 s in the lane's informal hyperfine run (status/std-hash.md, session 2); 12 rounds project about 1.1 s until a tools/bench publish times it.
Written by the std-hash lane (status/std-hash.md, session 2); checksums agree across all four columns at both sizes on the owner's machine, 2026-11-06.
